headline: Live chaos, dispatches, support links, and channel intel in one place.
subheadline: When Buttons is live, the stream takes over. When offline, the site flips into highlights, recap mode, and a Brigade briefing.

dispatch.title: This site is now the stream hub.
dispatch.body: No fake desktop. No maze. Just the live show, the latest recap, the commands people actually use, and the support links viewers keep asking for.
notes: Live state should be obvious instantly.
Offline state should still feel active, not abandoned.
Commands and support steps should be impossible to miss.

support.title: Donate Through Ko-fi
support.summary: Fastest direct support option for the stream and the weird work around it.
steps: Choose a one-time amount or recurring support if you want ongoing backing.
Add a message if you want the support callout tied to a stream moment or bit.
support.label: Open Ko-fi

support.title: Subscribe On Twitch
support.summary: Monthly support through Twitch, usually tied to emotes, perks, and direct channel support.
steps: Open the Twitch channel while signed in.
Use the Subscribe button on the channel page or inside the stream.
Choose the tier you want and complete checkout through Twitch.
support.label: Open Twitch Channel

support.title: Use A Free Prime Sub
support.summary: Best option for viewers who already have Amazon Prime and want to support without an extra monthly cost.
steps: Link Amazon Prime and Twitch through Prime Gaming.
Visit the Twitch channel while logged in.
Open Subscribe and choose the Prime option if it is available for the month.
support.label: Prime Gaming Setup
